profile.headline: Software Engineer at Dignitas Technologies
profile.summary:
I have been in the simulation and training field for 20+ years. Along the way, I am constantly looking for ways to expand my knowledge of current technologies. My experience with R&D to software engineering on small to very large programs of record has granted exposure to an array of complex systems.

Specialties: design and prototyping; Proper-cycle development experience with N-tier systems.

Experience with: Java technologies, server backend/infrastructure; C/C++, Android, scripting languages, git, gradle, maven, Agile processes

US Army Tactical Systems and Protocols: FBCB2, ASAS-L, CPOF, MCS, BCS, DCGS-A, AMDWS, AFATDS, PASS, DDS, JVFM, USMTF, 47001/B/C, R5-VMF, MIL-STD-6017, Cursor on Target

Operating Systems: experience with open source systems, OSX, and most forms of Windows

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android app for Army's STE program that provided status of ATAK within a VM.
Research and development of Intelligent Cyber Adversaries for simulated cyber attacks.
Developed various instrument panels for JSF's instructor station.
Integrated/enhanced 3D after action review capability for CPM-Next program
Research for urban crowd pedestrian movement modeling.
Development of a prototype for a system of systems plug and play architecture.
Traffic modeling of vehicles that involved stopping and changing lanes with reasoning of surrounding terrain.

positions.title: Software Analyst/Engineer
positions.description: Sr Developer on C2 Adapter middleware component. The adapter is situated between different tactical systems and constructive simulations. Often described as an n-tier system, it offers interoperability between completely disparate systems.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Distributed Terrain Databases
Composable Behavior Technologies
